evidence_summary: For any same-day shift pair, this predicate now adds 24 hours to an already valid gap: for example, an 18:00 end followed by a 22:00 start becomes 28 hours instead of 4, so `is_rest_period_compliant` incorrectly accepts a rest period below the 11-hour minimum. Negative overnight gaps are also left unwrapped; restore the negative-only condition so short same-day rests cannot be reported as compliant.
